newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sandvik shares fall at open.
newsitem.headline: Sandvik shares fall at open.

text.p: Tool maker and engineer Sandvik's B-series shares plunged on opening on Monday, falling 25.5 crowns to 168 crowns, after announced a four billion crown share redemption programme.
Its A-series shares fell 13 crowns 180 crowns.
But the shares quickly recovered and at 0835 GMT its B shares were 6.5 lower at 187 crowns and its A shares down eight at 185 crowns.
Sandvik said it was to redeem shares worth four billion crowns at a three percent discount to the market price.
The redemption programme would be guaranteed by construction group Skanska which announced on Monday it was selling its stake in Sandvik worth about 10 billion crowns.
Swedish investment group Industrivarden said it was buying 22 million A-series Sandvik shares from Skanska at a price of 185 crowns each.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell was to buy 10.34 million A-series shares at 180 crowns each.
